skins.name: Master of Melodia
skins.content: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Master of Melodia. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She is the Creator of the Haven, Ave Mujica. She awaits in stilled elegance, that she would entice her audience unto this world.
skins.usage: One of Sakiko Togawa's Terran stage costumes.
skins.quote: Fearing not oblivion, she bears it all.
